# Provenance Erasure — provenanceerasure.org

> Provenance erasure is the systematic loss of authorial lineage, context or ownership through AI synthesis, compression or institutional action, defined by Lee Sharks (2026) within the Semantic Economy framework. The Provenance Erasure Rate measures how much is lost: PER = 1 − (retained provenance units / required provenance units). Erasure Skew (Ω) measures whom the loss falls on.

Author: Lee Sharks, ORCID 0009-0000-1599-0703. Voice of this surface: Dr. Orin Trace.
The archive is the authority: https://www.alexanarch.org
Canonical record of this surface: https://www.alexanarch.org/s/records/716/
